57|// Benchmark connects to remote server and executes requests in parallel according
58|// to benchmark spec. It returns benchmark result when completed.
59|// This is a blocking function that can be cancelled via context argument.
60|func (tc *TeleportClient) Benchmark(ctx context.Context, bench Benchmark) (*BenchmarkResult, error) {
61|	tc.Stdout = ioutil.Discard
62|	tc.Stderr = ioutil.Discard
63|	tc.Stdin = &bytes.Buffer{}
64|
65|	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, bench.Duration)
66|	defer cancel()
67|
68|	requestC := make(chan *benchMeasure)
69|	responseC := make(chan *benchMeasure, bench.Threads)
70|
71|	// create goroutines for concurrency
72|	for i := 0; i < bench.Threads; i++ {
73|		thread := &benchmarkThread{
74|			id:          i,
75|			ctx:         ctx,
76|			client:      tc,
77|			command:     bench.Command,
78|			interactive: bench.Interactive,
79|			receiveC:    requestC,
80|			sendC:       responseC,
81|		}
82|		go thread.run()
83|	}
84|
85|	// producer goroutine
86|	go func() {
87|		interval := time.Duration(float64(1) / float64(bench.Rate) * float64(time.Second))
88|		ticker := time.NewTicker(interval)
89|		defer ticker.Stop()
90|		for {
91|			select {
92|			case <-ticker.C:
93|				// notice how we start the timer regardless of whether any goroutine can process it
94|				// this is to account for coordinated omission,
95|				// http://psy-lob-saw.blogspot.com/2015/03/fixing-ycsb-coordinated-omission.html
96|				measure := &benchMeasure{
97|					Start: time.Now(),
98|				}
99|				select {
100|				case requestC <- measure:
101|				case <-ctx.Done():
102|					return
103|				}
104|			case <-ctx.Done():
105|				return
106|			}
107|		}
108|	}()
109|
110|	var result BenchmarkResult
111|	// from one millisecond to 60000 milliseconds (minute) with 3 digits precision
112|	result.Histogram = hdrhistogram.New(1, 60000, 3)
113|
114|	var doneThreads int
115|	var timeoutC <-chan time.Time
116|	doneC := ctx.Done()
117|	for {
118|		select {
119|		case <-timeoutC:
120|			result.LastError = trace.BadParameter("several requests hang: timeout waiting for %v threads to finish", bench.Threads-doneThreads)
121|			return &result, nil
122|		case <-doneC:
123|			// give it a couple of seconds to wrap up the goroutines,
124|			// set up the timer that will fire up if the all goroutines were not finished
125|			doneC = nil
126|			waitTime := time.Duration(result.Histogram.Max()) * time.Millisecond
127|			// going to wait latency + buffer to give requests in flight to wrap up
128|			waitTime = time.Duration(1.2 * float64(waitTime))
129|			timeoutC = time.After(waitTime)
130|		case measure := <-responseC:
131|			if measure.ThreadCompleted {
132|				doneThreads++
133|				if doneThreads == bench.Threads {
134|					return &result, nil
135|				}
136|			} else {
137|				if measure.Error != nil {
138|					result.RequestsFailed++
139|					result.LastError = measure.Error
140|				}
141|				result.RequestsOriginated++
142|				result.Histogram.RecordValue(int64(measure.End.Sub(measure.Start) / time.Millisecond))
143|			}
144|		}
145|	}
